description.content:
Purpose
Fetches subnet and IP address usage data from Infoblox IPAM, compares it against NetBrain's discovered live network data, and publishes a CSV reconciliation report highlighting inconsistencies between the two systems.

Reconciliation Rules
1. IP is "USED" in Infoblox but not discovered in NetBrain -> recommended action: "Discover IP in NetBrain".
2. IP is discovered in NetBrain but not registered/USED in Infoblox -> recommended action: "Register IP in Infoblox".
3. IP is present and consistent on both sides -> recommended action: "No action".

Prerequisite
Create an External API Server in NetBrain (System > Integration > API Servers) using the built-in "Infoblox API Adapter", pointing to the Infoblox Grid Manager (e.g. https://gm.example.com) with a WAPI user/password that has read access to the network and ipv4address WAPI objects. The server's name must exactly match the infoblox.api_server_name input value below.

Input Parameters
- infoblox.api_server_name (required): Name of the External API Server registered in NetBrain that points to the Infoblox API Adapter. No default; the plugin fails if this is missing or the server cannot be found.
- infoblox.wapi_version (optional): Infoblox WAPI version, e.g. "v2.12". Defaults to "v2.10" if omitted.
- infoblox.network_view (optional): Infoblox network view filter, e.g. "default". Leave empty to query all views.
- infoblox.subnets (optional): Explicit list of subnet CIDR strings to reconcile, e.g. ["10.0.104.0/24"]. Leave empty ([]) to auto-discover all subnets from Infoblox via ipam:statistics.
- infoblox.max_results (optional): Max results returned per WAPI ipv4address query. Defaults to -100000; a negative value bypasses Infoblox's default 1000-result cap so large subnets are not truncated.
- netbrain_scope.site_path (optional): NetBrain Site full path (e.g. "My Network\Data Center A") used to scope the NetBrain side of the comparison to devices under that site. Leave empty to compare against the entire live network.
- netbrain_scope.include_child_sites (optional): Whether to include child sites when site_path is set. Defaults to true.

Output
A CSV report named "NetBrain-Infoblox-IP-Reconciliation-Report_<timestamp>.csv" with columns Subnet, IP_Address, In_NetBrain, In_Infoblox, Consistent, Recommended_Action, saved to Files > Public > Third Party System > Infoblox in the NetBrain desktop client.
